direct_findings.source_evidence: The adopted high-resolution receipt requires quantitative control of oscillations near discontinuities; printed pages 103–104 distinguish smooth and discontinuous portions.
direct_findings.lean_evidence: D053 accepts an arbitrary admitted predicate. D051's stability and oscillation fields quantify only over admitted arrays; automatic admission is required only for eventual projections of SpatialSmoothReferenceOn fields.
direct_findings.impact: The general target does not guarantee that any nonsmooth inputs are covered by its oscillation estimate. A separately supplied family admitting all arrays demonstrates one instance, not the required universal coverage.

direct_findings.source_evidence: The user convention requests coordinate-by-coordinate execution of supplied higher-order methods and error propagation.
direct_findings.lean_evidence: The actual-stage clause is ∀n,cell ∃p,L ∀q ∃C,N, N≤(method n).level ... → estimate.
direct_findings.impact: Choosing N one greater than the selected level makes the accuracy implication true without any estimate. The separate family-wide eventual accuracy clause does not force the actual execution level to reach its threshold.

direct_findings.source_evidence: Q10 supplies connectivity, physical volumes and shared normal fluxes. The literal high-resolution receipt leaves norm, CFL and total-variation choices unspecified.
direct_findings.lean_evidence: D051 adds uniform pairwise maximum-norm Lipschitz stability; D053 adds mesh comparability and fixed-window refinement conditions; D061 fixes ghost values; D063 assumes synchronized levels and exact linewise area/volume/flux realization.
direct_findings.impact: These conditions narrow applicability. They cannot be justified as stronger conclusions or attributed to the printed source or literal user answer.
